level_form.label: Level and form
level_form.meaning: Recent adjusted strokes gained: who is good and how hot or cold

kalman.label: Kalman trend
kalman.meaning: State-space skill estimate updated after every round

xtour.label: Cross-tour
xtour.meaning: Evidence from feeder/Asian/other tours (matters for thin PGA/DPWT records)

category.label: Category skills
category.meaning: Off-the-tee, approach, short game, putting and distance signals

act.label: Activity
act.meaning: How much he has been playing

sklv.label: Skill level
sklv.meaning: Empirical-Bayes posterior, hot/cold hand, trend slope

course.label: Course fit and history
course.meaning: Distance/accuracy fit to this venue and past results here

thin.label: Thin-data shrink
thin.meaning: Shrinkage of short records toward a tour/entry-route prior

override.label: Owner override
override.meaning: One-off skill change set on the private site

weather.label: NOT APPLIED IN PRICES: tee times, waves and the weather forecast are shown for review only. The Wednesday arm (late-wave flag + forecast wave wind) is a labelled view, not a price input (it failed the R1 matchup test); realised weather is never an input.

what_drives_scoring: Par 5s play -0.40 vs par with a 49% birdie-or-better rate: the scoring holes, where length and a good week pay off.
Skill separates players most on par 4s (sensitivity 1.00).
Field-average scoring -1.41 vs par per round; 4.4 birdies+ and 2.7 bogeys+ per round.
Best course fit (distance/accuracy): Shipley, Neal, Smith, Jordan, Koivun, Jackson. Worst: Johnson, Zach J., Todd, Brendon, Campos, Rafael.
Course variance multiplier (median 1.03): a typical spread of outcomes.

finish.calibration_note: replay vs the run's published model probabilities (30k x 5 seeds there, n_draws here); win/top-N deviations of a few MC standard errors are expected

edge_model.note: edge_sg = (model - market) in strokes per round via the model's own logit slope per market. attribution = ridge share of that gap loading on each field-relative component: a statistical attribution, not causal
